items.title: The blowup over an affine open is the Proj of the Rees algebra
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent ideal I on X, an affine open U = Spec(A) with ideal I, and the blowup b : X' -> X in I, there is a canonical isomorphism of b^{-1}(U) with Proj of the Rees algebra of I in A, and b^{-1}(U) is covered by the affine spectra of the affine blowup algebras A[I/a] (source lines 8321-8334). The proof reads the first statement off the glueing construction of the relative Proj, and then shows that the degree-one elements a^{(1)} generate the Rees algebra, so that the Proj is covered by the affine opens D_+(a^{(1)}) which are the spectra of the affine blowup algebras.
